phase_delta.reason: Fleet/bucket mode has no Raft phase snapshots

limits: Same compiler/source/client across four durability modes. This is not a before/after optimization experiment.
Failed cases retain all failed and unmeasured windows. Only completely passing cases receive descriptive aggregate bins; there is no complete four-mode comparison without every case passing.

Inclusive phase timings overlap and include background/verification work. SQL publish measures producer completion/reconciliation checks, not physical applier publication; failed checks are not counts of failed requests or failed image writes.
Node lease-expiry markers and process exit are recorded separately; exit after load does not establish when expiry began.
Observed uncertain input bodies do not establish an exact receipt, acknowledgement or S3 proof. No fresh-ID retry of an ambiguous mutation.
One Colima VM is one physical failure domain. Full feature, crash, movement, authority and CG/OPT gates remain open.
